description:
What this is. A grid of everybody against every day of the month, colour-coded, with a letter for each kind of leave.

What to do. Check here first whenever attendance looks wrong. It shows the whole month in one screen, so a person or a day that has gone astray stands out before you go digging.

Where to find it. Under Reports, as Monthly Attendance Sheet.
name: Review the Monthly Attendance Sheet
report_description: Monthly attendance per employee, with this app's colouring and leave abbreviations.
title: Monthly Attendance Sheet — the month at a glance
